title: Caledonian envoy
html_source:
Joyce may be referring to Scottish (Caledonian) embryologist John Beard.

John Beard (1858 – 1924) was a Scottish embryologist, known for his controversial theory of the trophoblastic origin of cancer and his experimental treatments of cancer by means of pancreatic enzymes. Wikipedia
